ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

SELECT DISTINCT
COUNT(BUSINESS_LEVELS.LEVEL_ID) INTO V_COUNT
FROM 
BUSINESS_LEVELS, 
CODE_FNS, 
TASKS, 
PORT_TYPES, 
DCLTN_TYPES, 
DCLTN_STATUS

WHERE 

((CODE_FNS.BUS_LEVEL_ID = BUSINESS_LEVELS.LEVEL_ID)
 AND (CODE_FNS.TASK_ID = TASKS.TASK_ID)
 AND (CODE_FNS.PORT_TYPE_ID = PORT_TYPES.TYPE_ID(+))
 AND (CODE_FNS.STA_CD = DCLTN_STATUS.DCLTN_STA_CD(+)
 AND CODE_FNS.DCLTN_TYPE = DCLTN_STATUS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD(+) )
 AND (DCLTN_STATUS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN_TYPES.TYPE_ID(+))) 
 AND
( 
(CODE_FNS.TASK_ID=:P_TASK_ID OR :P_TASK_ID IS NULL)
AND
(
 (CODE_FNS.DCLTN_TYPE IN (1,2) AND (:P_STATS_TYPE=0) )
 OR
 (CODE_FNS.DCLTN_TYPE IN (3,4,5,6)AND (:P_STATS_TYPE=1) ) 
 OR
 (:P_STATS_TYPE IS NULL)
)
AND
( 
CODE_FNS.BUS_LEVEL_ID=:P_LEVEL_ID OR :P_LEVEL_ID IS NULL
)
AND
(
CODE_FNS.PORT_TYPE_ID=:P_PORT_TYPE_ID OR :P_PORT_TYPE_ID IS NULL
)
AND
(CODE_FNS.EXEC_CODE=:P_FUN OR :P_FUN IS NULL)

);
 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 if v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_TASK_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_TASK_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_STATS_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_STATS_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LEVEL_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LEVEL_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_TYPE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_TYPE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FUN',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_FUN);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
END ;
